show.description:
London Wale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge is a romantic comedy about Arjun Malhotra,a billionaire’s carefree son who fails his exams in London. Instead of giving him the family empire, his father sends him to India to live like a common man and earn success from scratch.

Working at a Delhi garage, Arjun falls for Simran, the owner’s daughter. But her arrogant boyfriend Rohit has plans to grab her family’s property. Arjun must win love and prove his worth not as a rich heir, but as a real man. WATCH NOW
